editorial:
Imagine being a little girl who is totally dead but still wants to hang out and make friends. That is exactly what you get with this weird and wild ride. You follow Evelyn, a spooky kid who is tired of being lonely in the afterlife. She comes up with a crazy plan to get her life back, but as you will see, her version of making friends is a bit more violent than most. It feels like a dark fairy tale mixed with a goofy horror movie, making it a perfect pick for a rainy night when you want something strange but fun.

You will really love how the movie balances the creepy stuff with actual jokes. The acting is great, especially since the kid manages to be both sweet and scary at the same time. Some parts move a bit slow in the middle, but the ending makes up for it. If you enjoy movies that do not take themselves too seriously, you should definitely check this out. It looks great if you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but you might also enjoy renting it on Apple TV for a quick movie night.
endingExplained: At the very end, you find out that Evelyn cannot actually stay alive without taking someone else's place. She tries to trick a living girl into swapping souls so she can finally be a normal kid again. However, the plan backfires when the spirits of other dead children stop her. She realizes she cannot escape her fate and eventually fades back into the afterlife, finally finding peace with her fellow ghost friends.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark humor and creepy kids in movies.
